checks: Initial/hover context zero without any observed target change
Observed target change updates segment BEFORE current feature; same-point before/after goals differ
1000 variable-dt measured samples preserve every original74 float32 value exactly, including on goal changes
100 global-yaw rotations/translations preserve heading-frame path features
Degenerate changed segment length squared<=1e-15 gives zero, without fabricated direction
Unseen intermediate target is never invented: an observed A-to-C jump uses A-to-C; missed waypoints cannot be detected
Final hold intentionally retains last finite leg indefinitely; no completion/phase input
Finite correction has no metric/feature clipping; .25m is only an engineering scale
Reset clears path and original74 memory together; new first target does not create a leg
7 invalid/missing-target or dt cases reject without advancing target memory
semantic_checks.scale_interpretation: Engineering normalization chosen by root; no quality or optimality claim

archived_geometry.sample_semantics: Archived measured post-motion position with judged PRE-update target for its preceding physical interval. This tests current-sample finite geometry. It is NOT a replay of next native actor observations, which may use POST-update next_target. The API supplies identical current target/current p/current rotation/dt to old74 and new3; a future env wrapper must preserve actor-time causality separately.

fresh_optimizer.treatment: New empty Adam state explicitly replaces pre-calibration historical optimizer; no optimizer step or gradient taken

sb3_lift.counter_warning: All inherited counters describe old source learning only. This77D lift has ZERO new training/optimizer/environment steps; future refinement must explicitly reset counters/optimizer and configure its same77D prior

limits: No evidence that explicit features cause or will fix quality; fixed-route implicit leg inference remains possible
No new environment wrapper, trainer, Gazebo runtime or inference auditor; this contract is not deployable in the frozen74 runtime
Archived geometry compares PRE-update judged target rows, not POST-update next actor observations
Only previously OBSERVED targets are stored; no proof of visit/arrival is added; unseen targets cannot be reconstructed
Discrete target changes are compared exactly; continuously moving targets require a different contract
Final leg remains active during final hold; initial/no-change/degenerate leg features are zero
